items.title: PathoEvo: an interactive single-cell database for exploring disease progression and pathological evolution
items.title_zh: PathoEvo：一个用于探索疾病进展和病理演化的交互式单细胞数据库
items.summary_zh: 摘要 疾病进展由组织微环境、细胞组成、细胞状态和转录程序的协调变化驱动。单细胞和单核RNA测序使这些变化能够在细胞分辨率下进行研究。然而，公共疾病相关数据集通常组织在单个研究内，并使用异质的临床、病理或分子分期系统进行注释，限制了跨疾病阶段和数据集之间的比较。在此，我们介绍PathoEvo（https://biomedlab-ai.com/pathoevo/），一个以疾病进展为中心的疾病相关单细胞和单核转录组数据库。PathoEvo整合了来自981个样本和59个数据集的7,452,971个细胞或细胞核，覆盖18种疾病和27个进展框架。通过人工策展、统一处理、元数据协调、细胞类型注释和阶段映射，PathoEvo将异质数据集组织成围绕疾病进展的标准化资源。其数据和分析功能跨越三个互补层次，允许用户检查与疾病阶段和细胞状态相关的细胞组成变化，表征跨疾病进展的样本级分子变异，并研究相关细胞群体和样

extra.description: Abstract Disease progression is driven by coordinated changes in tissue microenvironments, cellular composition, cell states, and transcriptional programmes. Single-cell and single-nucleus RNA sequencing enable these changes to be studied at cellular resolution. However, public disease-associated datasets are often organized within individual studies and annotated using heterogeneous clinical, pathological, or molecular staging systems, limiting comparison across disease stages and datasets. Here, we present PathoEvo (https://biomedlab-ai.com/pathoevo/), a disease-associated single-cell and single-nucleus transcriptomic database centred on disease progression. PathoEvo integrates 7 452 971 cells or nuclei from 981 samples and 59 datasets, covering 18 diseases and 27 progression frameworks. Through manual curation, unified processing, metadata harmonization, cell-type annotation, and stage mapping, PathoEvo organizes heterogeneous datasets into standardized resources organized around disease progression. Its data and analytical functions span three complementary levels, allowing users to examine changes in cellular composition associated with disease stage and cell states, characterize sample-level molecular variation across disease progression, and investigate gene expression dynamics across relevant cell populations and samples. Structured search and browsing further facilitate dataset discovery and navigation of stage-resolved information across diseases and staging systems. PathoEvo provides an integrative resource for investigating pathological evolution and comparing cellular and molecular patterns of disease progression across datasets at single-cell resolution.

items.title: RankMap: rank-based reference mapping for fast and robust cell type annotation in spatial and single-cell transcriptomics
items.title_zh: RankMap：基于排名的参考映射，用于空间和单细胞转录组学中快速稳健的细胞类型注释

items.title: STRAND: a comprehensive subcellular-resolved spatial transcriptome RNA architecture and navigation database
items.title_zh: STRAND：一个全面的亚细胞分辨率空间转录组RNA架构与导航数据库
items.summary_zh: 摘要：亚细胞RNA定位是控制细胞极化、局部翻译和功能区室化的关键调控层。高分辨率空间转录组学的最新进展为在单分子分辨率下解析这些细胞内架构提供了前所未有的机会。然而，相关数据集分散于各研究和存储库中，处理程序和标准差异很大，严重限制了跨研究复用。为弥合这一差距，我们推出STRAND（亚细胞分辨率空间转录组RNA架构与导航数据库），一个用于自动采集、质量控制和解读亚细胞空间转录组学数据的精选数据资源与分析平台。通过智能体辅助的策展流程，STRAND已从六大平台汇编了35个亚细胞分辨率数据集，覆盖人类和小鼠的17种组织类型，总计约49亿个转录本坐标。基于这一标准化数据资源，STRAND提供了涵盖细胞分割评估、细胞类型注释、RNA定位/共定位模式注释和亚细胞区室推断的分析工作流。两个案例研究表明，STRAND成功识别了培养细胞系中已确立的RNA定位模式，并检测了心肌细胞中药物诱导的RNA重定位。

extra.description: Abstract Subcellular RNA localization serves as a critical regulatory layer governing cellular polarization, local translation, and functional compartmentalization. Recent advances in high-resolution spatial transcriptomics have provided unprecedented opportunities to resolve these intracellular architectures at single-molecule resolution. However, relevant datasets are dispersed across studies and repositories, vary substantially in processing procedures and standards, severely limiting their cross-study reuse. To bridge this gap, we present STRAND (Subcellular-Resolved Spatial Transcriptome RNA Architecture and Navigation Database), a curated data resource and analysis platform for the automated harvesting, quality control, and interpretation of subcellular spatial transcriptomics data. Through an agent-assisted curation pipeline, STRAND has assembled 35 subcellular-resolution datasets from six major platforms, covering 17 tissue types in human and mouse and totalling ∼4.9 billion transcript coordinates. Building upon this standardized data resource, STRAND provides an analytical workflow spanning cell segmentation evaluation, cell-type annotation, RNA localization/colocalization pattern annotation, and subcellular compartment inference. Two case studies demonstrate that STRAND successfully identifies established RNA localization patterns in cultured cell lines and detects drug-induced RNA relocalization in cardiomyocytes. STRAND is openly available at https://strand.phasep.pro.

items.title: Cd47 deficiency in mouse brain under excitotoxic stress
items.title_zh: 兴奋性毒性应激下小鼠大脑中Cd47的缺失
items.summary_zh: CD47是一种具有明确免疫和神经发育作用的跨膜蛋白，最近被鉴定为人类、非人灵长类和小鼠中丰富的突触前蛋白。为研究Cd47如何影响神经元应激和损伤，我们对暴露于惊厥剂量（KA25；25 mg/kg）或亚惊厥剂量（KA3；3 mg/kg）海人藻酸（KA）的野生型（WT）和Cd47敲除（KO）小鼠海马进行了单核RNA测序。将细胞类型注释与加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）相结合，揭示了不同的神经元和胶质基因模块，其共表达结构因基因型和KA暴露而异。值得注意的是，某些模块仅在Cd47缺陷细胞中显示出与KA相关的共表达结构变化。这些模块的富集分析突出了翻译、生物能量和突触基因集。使用Wasserstein距离比较全转录组分布表明，在所有十五个成对比较中，载体处理的KO细胞最接近暴露于KA3的WT细胞。这些发现表明，Cd47缺失使海马转录组向类似轻度兴奋性毒性应激的状态转变，暗示Cd47是神经元应激

extra.description: CD47, a transmembrane protein with well-established immune and neurodevelopmental roles, was recently identified as an abundant presynaptic protein in humans, non-human primates, and mice. To investigate how Cd47 influences neuronal stress and injury, we performed single-nucleus RNA sequencing of hippocampi from wild-type (WT) and Cd47 knockout (KO) mice exposed to kainic acid (KA) at convulsive (KA25; 25 mg/kg) or subconvulsive (KA3; 3 mg/kg) doses. Integrating cell-type annotations with Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA) revealed distinct neuronal and glial gene modules whose co-expression structure differed by genotype and by KA exposure. Notably, certain modules showed KA-associated changes in co-expression structure only in Cd47 -deficient cells. Enrichment analyses of these modules highlighted translational, bioenergetic, and synaptic gene sets. Comparing transcriptome-wide distributions using Wasserstein distance demonstrated that vehicle-treated KO cells most closely resembled WT cells exposed to KA3, of all fifteen pairwise comparisons. These findings suggest that Cd47 loss shifts the hippocampal transcriptome toward a state resembling mild excitotoxic stress, implicating Cd47 as a candidate regulator of neuronal stress adaptation and providing a hypothesis for testing that role.

items.title: An extensible deep learning framework for multi-type chromatin interaction prediction through hierarchical adaptation strategies
items.title_zh: 一个通过分层适应策略进行多类型染色质相互作用预测的可扩展深度学习框架
items.summary_zh: 三维染色质相互作用在基因调控中起重要作用，然而多种相互作用类型的计算预测在很大程度上仍依赖于专门的单任务模型。在这里，我们提出UniLoopNet，一个多任务深度学习框架，可从DNA序列预测多种类型的染色质相互作用，包括增强子-启动子相互作用、增强子-增强子相互作用、CTCF介导的环和条纹相关相互作用。UniLoopNet采用共享编码器-解码器架构和分层适应策略，基于任务语义相似性整合多任务、迁移和持续学习。跨多个细胞系的全面基准测试表明，UniLoopNet优于现有的专门和多任务方法，大多数任务的AUROC超过0.90。在严格评估设置下，包括染色体匹配、距离匹配、现实不平衡和位点不相交测试，AUROC范围为0.8934至0.9366。在现实的1:5类别不平衡设置中，增强子-启动子和增强子-增强子相互作用预测的AUPRC分别为0.7956和0.6935。跨细胞系迁移实验进一步表明，将Uni

extra.description: Three-dimensional chromatin interactions play essential roles in gene regulation, yet computational prediction of diverse interaction types remains largely dependent on specialized, single-task models. Here, we present UniLoopNet, a multi-task deep learning framework that predicts multiple types of chromatin interactions including enhancer–promoter interactions, enhancer–enhancer interactions, CTCF-mediated loops, and stripe-associated interactions from DNA sequences. UniLoopNet employs a shared encoder–decoder architecture with hierarchical adaptation strategies, integrating multi-task, transfer, and continual learning based on task semantic similarity. Comprehensive benchmarking across multiple cell lines demonstrates that UniLoopNet outperforms existing specialized and multi-task approaches, with AUROCs exceeding 0.90 in most tasks. Under stringent evaluation settings, including chromosome-matched, distance-matched, realistic imbalanced, and locus-disjoint tests, AUROCs range from 0.8934 to 0.9366. In the realistic 1:5 class-imbalance setting, the AUPRCs for enhancer–promoter and enhancer–enhancer interaction prediction are 0.7956 and 0.6935, respectively. Cross-cell-line transfer experiments further show that applying UniLoopNet to another cell line requires adaptation by supervised fine-tuning on target-cell-line data, after which performance is comparable to that of within-cell-line training. Notably, the framework exhibits data efficiency in experiments with substantially reduced training data. Interpretability analyses reveal that the learned sequence features are associated with known transcription factor binding sites and uncover differential regulatory effects of disease-associated variants. UniLoopNet provides a versatile and data-efficient framework for sequence-based prediction and interpretation of diverse 3D genome interactions, complementing existing sequence-to-map approaches while improving the understanding of sequence-encoded regulatory potential.

items.title: CAnDi: a global catalogue of anaerobic digestion microbiomes
items.title_zh: CAnDi：全球厌氧消化微生物组目录
items.summary_zh: 摘要 产甲烷环境孕育着复杂的原核生物群落，驱动有机物厌氧转化为甲烷和二氧化碳。除了对全球碳循环至关重要外，这些过程已被引导为生物反应器中用于能源生产的强大生物技术。解码这些群落的功能和分类景观需要全面调查，包括噬菌体和质粒，然而这些在当前数据库中仍然严重代表性不足。在此，我们介绍微生物厌氧消化目录（CAnDi），一个包含从全球1256个生物反应器采集的宏基因组样本中恢复的11,149个物种的36,480个原核基因组的数据库。重建的宏基因组还编码了约190万个病毒序列和超过13万个质粒序列。同一性聚类揭示了约53.6万个候选病毒物种，其中85%相对于现有数据库是新的，以及超过15,000个独特质粒。病毒和质粒蛋白簇从头生成，分别总计1,721,182和123,813个不同蛋白家族。总之，这些资源大幅推进了先前表征厌氧消化微生物组的系统方法，为研究病毒组和质粒组在产甲烷生态系统中的生态和进化作

extra.description: Abstract Methanogenic environments harbour complex prokaryotic consortia that drive the anaerobic conversion of organic matter into methane and carbon dioxide. Beyond being key to the global carbon cycle, such processes have been steered into powerful biotechnologies for energy production in bioreactors. Decoding the functional and taxonomic landscape of these communities requires comprehensive surveys, including bacteriophages and plasmids, which, however, remain vastly underrepresented in current databases. Here, we present the microbial Catalogue of Anaerobic Digestion (CAnDi), a database comprising 36 480 prokaryotic genomes spanning 11 149 species recovered from 1256 metagenomic samples collected across bioreactors worldwide. The reconstructed metagenomes also encode ∼1.9 million viral and over 130 000 plasmid sequences. Identity clustering revealed ∼536 000 candidate viral species, of which 85% are novel relative to existing databases, as well as over 15 000 unique plasmids. Clusters of viral and plasmid proteins were generated de novo, totalling 1 721 182 and 123 813 distinct protein families, respectively. Together, these resources substantially advance previous systematic approaches to characterize anaerobic digestion microbiomes, providing an expanded foundation for investigating the ecological and evolutionary roles of the virome and plasmidome in methane-producing ecosystems. CAnDi is accessible via https://www.candi-db.org/.

items.title: Multi-omics survival prediction under modality incompleteness via dynamic modality graphs and product-of-experts fusion
items.title_zh: 通过动态模态图和专家乘积融合在模态不完整下的多组学生存预测
items.summary_zh: 摘要 多组学数据整合为癌症生存预测提供了丰富的互补信息，然而模态不完整在真实医疗数据中普遍存在，削弱了现有模型的稳定性和适用性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出DMG-PoE，一个用于多组学生存预测的稳健学习框架。该框架引入动态模态图（DMG），在模态节点之间传播互补信息以补偿缺失输入，并结合不确定性感知的专家乘积（PoE）融合机制，按每个模态的估计精度自适应加权，以及一致性约束训练策略，在不同模态子集上稳定预测。在SurvBoard基准上对10种TCGA癌症类型和七种组学模态的系统评估表明，DMG-PoE在标准设置（完整模态训练/测试）和缺失增强设置（训练额外包含真实不完整样本和非临床模态丢弃，仅完整测试）下均取得最高平均C-index；受控的逐模态掩蔽实验在22/24个癌症-模态组合中验证了有效的测试时恢复，而仅七种模态中两种可用时的跨队列迁移进一步证实了严重输入限制下的泛化能力。

extra.description: Abstract Multi-omics data integration provides rich complementary information for cancer survival prediction, yet modality incompleteness is pervasive in real-world medical data and undermines the stability and applicability of existing models. To address this challenge, we propose DMG-PoE, a robust learning framework for multi-omics survival prediction. The framework introduces a dynamic modality graph (DMG) that propagates complementary information across modality nodes to compensate for missing inputs, combined with an uncertainty-aware product-of-experts (PoE) fusion mechanism that adaptively weights each modality by its estimated precision, and a consistency-constrained training strategy that stabilizes predictions across varying modality subsets. Systematic evaluation on the SurvBoard benchmark across 10 TCGA cancer types and seven omics modalities demonstrates that DMG-PoE achieves the highest average C-index under both the standard setting (complete-modality training/testing) and the missing-augmented setting (training additionally includes real incomplete samples and nonclinical modality dropout, with complete-only testing); controlled per-modality masking experiments validate effective test-time recovery in 22/24 cancer-modality combinations, and cross-cohort transfer with only two of seven modalities available further confirms generalization under severe input restriction.

items.title: The recount3 Python package for programmatic access to uniformly processed RNA-seq data
items.title_zh: 用于程序化访问统一处理RNA-seq数据的recount3 Python包
items.summary_zh: 摘要：recount3在线资源提供了来自序列读取档案等主要测序存储库的数万个经统一处理的人类和小鼠RNA-seq样本。虽然这些数据集的访问传统上以R/Bioconductor生态系统为中心，但Python在生物信息学和机器学习中的日益突出地位要求为Python用户提供原生、高效的工具。因此，我们推出recount3 Python包，提供稳健的应用程序编程接口（API）和命令行界面（CLI），用于发现、下载和物化recount3资源。该软件协调统一资源定位符（URL）解析、持久磁盘缓存以及自动将数据解析为可分析的数据结构，包括Pandas DataFrame和BiocPy RangedSummarizedExperiment对象。recount3 Python包大幅降低了在基于Python的计算流程中大规模利用RNA-seq数据的门槛，弥合了海量公共转录组数据与现代机器学习生态系统之间的差距

extra.description: Abstract The recount3 online resource provides tens of thousands of uniformly processed RNA-seq samples across human and mouse from major sequencing repositories like the Sequence Read Archive. While access to these datasets has traditionally been centered in the R/Bioconductor ecosystem, the growing prominence of Python in bioinformatics and machine learning necessitates native, efficient tooling for Python users. Therefore, we present the recount3 Python package with robust application programming interface (API) and command-line interface (CLI) for discovering, downloading, and materializing recount3 resources. The software orchestrates uniform resource locator (URL) resolution, persistent on-disk caching, and the automatic parsing of data into analysis-ready data structures, including Pandas DataFrames and BiocPy RangedSummarizedExperiment objects. The recount3 Python package drastically lowers the barrier to entry for large-scale utilization of RNA-seq data in Python-based computational pipelines, bridging the gap between massive public transcriptomic data and modern machine learning ecosystems.

items.title: CircaVal: a gene-centric multi-omics platform for exploring circadian regulatory features
items.title_zh: CircaVal：一个以基因为中心的多组学平台，用于探索昼夜节律调控特征
items.summary_zh: 摘要 昼夜节律时钟通过协调多个分子层面上时钟控制基因表达来编排每日生理过程。然而，这种多层节律调控的系统表征仍然具有挑战性，因为相关信息分布在独立数据集中，且节律性使用多种分析方法评估。在此，我们开发了CircaVal，一个以基因为中心的多组学平台，用于整合探索和解释人类、小鼠和狒狒的昼夜节律调控特征。为支持该框架，CircaVal使用标准化的、数据类型特定的流程处理公共数据集，并将基因节律性与组织特异性表达、跨物种直系同源、功能注释和多组学调控特征整合。CircaVal进一步引入了整合节律性评分（IRS），它结合多种节律检测方法的一致性和独立数据集间的可重复性，为优先考虑候选节律基因提供定量基础。该平台使用户能够检查跨数据集的基因节律性、识别组织富集的节律基因、比较跨物种的节律性并探索相关调控特征。附加功能包括交互式以基因为中心的探索、基因组浏览器可视化、用户上传时间序列数据的节律性分析

extra.description: Abstract The circadian clock orchestrates daily physiological processes through coordinated regulation of clock-controlled gene expression across multiple molecular layers. However, systematic characterization of this multilayered rhythmic regulation remains challenging because relevant information is distributed across independent datasets and rhythmicity is evaluated using diverse analytical approaches. Here, we developed CircaVal, a gene-centric multi-omics platform for the integrated exploration and interpretation of circadian regulatory features in humans, mice, and baboons. To support this framework, CircaVal processes public datasets using standardized, data-type-specific pipelines, and gene rhythmicity is integrated with tissue-specific expression, cross-species orthology, functional annotations, and multi-omics regulatory features. CircaVal further introduces an integrated rhythmicity score (IRS), which combines concordance across multiple rhythm-detection methods with reproducibility across independent datasets to provide a quantitative basis for prioritizing candidate rhythmic genes. The platform enables users to examine gene rhythmicity across datasets, identify tissue-enriched rhythmic genes, compare rhythmicity across species, and explore associated regulatory features. Additional functions include interactive gene-centric exploration, genome-browser visualization, rhythmicity analysis of user-uploaded time-series data, and programmatic data access. Together, these capabilities provide an integrated framework for rhythmic gene prioritization and gene-level interpretation of circadian regulatory features across tissues, species, datasets, and omics data types. CircaVal is freely available at https://CircaVal.com.

items.title: RNAactDrug 2.0: an updated resource for systematically exploring molecular features associated with drug sensitivity across multi-omics datasets
items.title_zh: RNAactDrug 2.0：一个更新的资源，用于系统探索跨多组学数据集中与药物敏感性相关的分子特征
items.summary_zh: 摘要 RNAactDrug 2.0（可在https://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/RNAactDrug或https://bio-datamining.hrbmu.edu.cn/RNAactDrug获取）是一个更新的资源，用于系统探索跨多组学数据集中与药物敏感性相关的分子特征。我们更新了RNAactDrug 2.0数据库，显著扩展了数据并改进了功能，包括：(i) 来自大规模药物基因组学数据库的约30 000种药物、38 908个RNA分子和22 800 375个药物–RNA关联，涵盖四个分子层：表达、拷贝数变异（CNV）、突变和甲基化；(ii) 整合了来自The Cancer Genome Atlas的33种癌症类型的11 099个病例，以支持药物敏感性相关RNA特征的临床和泛癌分析；(iii) 来自>200个单细胞RNA测序数据集的约380万个细胞，涵盖34种癌症类

extra.description: Abstract RNAactDrug 2.0 (available at https://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/RNAactDrug or https://bio-datamining.hrbmu.edu.cn/RNAactDrug) is an updated resource for systematically exploring molecular features associated with drug sensitivity across multi-omics datasets. We have updated the RNAactDrug 2.0 database with significantly expanded data and improved features, including (i) ∼30 000 drugs, 38 908 RNA molecules, and 22 800 375 drug–RNA associations from large-scale pharmacogenomic databases, covering four molecular layers: expression, copy number variation (CNV), mutation, and methylation; (ii) 11 099 cases from The Cancer Genome Atlas across 33 cancer types are integrated to support clinical and pan-cancer analyses of drug sensitivity-associated RNA features; (iii) ∼3.8 million cells from >200 single-cell RNA sequencing datasets, spanning 34 cancer types and 38 tissues, enable analysis of cell type-specific patterns and intratumoral heterogeneity; (iv) 26 440 enhancers and 788 444 drug-enhancer associations, combined with potential target prediction, provide an exploratory epigenetic regulatory dimension; (v) enhanced search and browsing functionalities, together with seven tools for functional annotation, pan-cancer analysis, tumor microenvironment profiling, single-cell trajectory and CNV analysis, and enhancer-related analyses. In summary, RNAactDrug 2.0 is a crucial resource for the multi-omics dissection of drug sensitivity-associated molecules, providing important support for the discovery of drug resistance biomarkers and the advancement of personalized therapeutic strategies.

items.title: SpatioCAD: Context-aware graph diffusion model for pinpointing spatially variable genes in heterogeneous tissues
items.title_zh: SpatioCAD：用于在异质组织中精确定位空间变异基因的上下文感知图扩散模型
items.summary_zh: 空间转录组学能够全面表征组织结构，识别空间变异基因（SVG）是定义区域特异性分子标记和揭示多样生物背景下空间调控机制的关键步骤。然而，大多数现有SVG检测方法忽视了细胞密度变化，这是肿瘤等复杂组织中的主要混杂因素，异质性细胞密度常导致假阳性。在此我们提出SpatioCAD，一个明确将真实空间表达模式与细胞密度驱动的混杂效应解耦的计算框架。SpatioCAD引入图扩散模型，内在纳入细胞密度感知条件以模拟表达传播，支持在广泛表达水平范围内识别SVG。在模拟数据集上的系统评估表明其具有优越的统计功效和特异性。应用于乳腺癌、肺癌和胶质瘤数据集，SpatioCAD识别出功能多样的SVG，包括在肿瘤进展中已确立作用的低丰度转录本，同时重现了具有生物学意义的组织结构特征。重要的是，SpatioCAD速度快且可扩展至大型组织。

extra.description: Spatial transcriptomics enables comprehensive characterization of tissue architecture, and the identification of spatially variable genes (SVGs) is a critical step for defining region-specific molecular markers and uncovering spatially regulated mechanisms across diverse biological contexts. However, most existing methods for SVG detection overlook cell density variations, a major confounding factor in complex tissues such as tumors, where heterogeneous cellularity frequently introduces false-positive calls. Here we present SpatioCAD, a computational framework that explicitly decouples genuine spatial expression patterns from confounding effects driven by cellularity. SpatioCAD introduces a graph diffusion model that inherently incorporates cell-density-aware conditions to simulate expression propagation, supporting the identification of SVGs across a broad range of expression levels. Systematic evaluations on simulated datasets demonstrate its superior statistical power and specificity. Applied to breast cancer, lung cancer, and glioma datasets, SpatioCAD identifies functionally diverse SVGs, including low‑abundance transcripts with established roles in tumor progression, while also recapitulates biologically meaningful tissue architecture features. Importantly, SpatioCAD is fast and scalable to large tissues.

items.title: ADInteractome: discovering Alzheimer’s disease-associated gene interactions from single-nucleus RNA-seq data through neural interaction states
items.title_zh: ADInteractome：通过神经交互状态从单核RNA-seq数据中发现阿尔茨海默病相关基因相互作用
items.summary_zh: 摘要 阿尔茨海默病（AD）是一种常见的神经退行性疾病，以淀粉样β斑块和tau缠结为特征，但其分子机制仍不清楚。单核RNA测序（snRNA-seq）的进展为AD相关大脑的细胞异质性提供了深刻见解。在本研究中，我们介绍ADInteractome，一个可解释的人工智能框架，旨在直接从在脑细胞snRNA-seq数据上训练的神经网络内部状态中发现与AD相关的基因相互作用。该方法基于这样的直觉：如果神经网络能够根据snRNA-seq数据准确分类来自AD和非AD供体的细胞，那么其内部交互状态——反映基因表达数据中的相互作用模式——对于识别具有生物学意义的基因相互作用是有信息量的。应用于西雅图阿尔茨海默病脑细胞图谱的大规模snRNA-seq数据集，ADInteractome揭示了细胞类型特异性和AD相关的基因回路，并得到现有文献支持。结果进一步得到我们的虚拟敲除和敲入实验的支持，这是通过数据驱动方法探究我

extra.description: Abstract Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is a prevalent neurodegenerative disorder characterized by amyloid $\beta $ plaques and tau tangles, yet its molecular mechanisms remain elusive. Advances in single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNA-seq) have provided profound insights into the cellular heterogeneity of AD-associated brains. In this study, we introduce ADInteractome, an interpretable artificial intelligence framework designed to discover gene interactions associated with AD directly from the internal state of neural networks trained on the snRNA-seq data of brain cells. The method is based on the intuition that if a neural network can accurately classify cells from AD and non-AD donors based on their snRNA-seq data, then its internal interaction states, reflecting interaction patterns within the gene expression data, are informative for identifying biologically meaningful gene interactions. Applied to a large-scale snRNA-seq dataset from the Seattle Alzheimer’s Disease Brain Cell Atlas, ADInteractome reveals cell-type-specific and AD-associated gene circuits supported by existing literature. The results were further supported by our virtual knock-out and knock-in experiments, a novel concept to probe our findings through a data-driven approach. Compared with traditional co-expression network methods, it achieves stronger enrichment for known AD-associated gene interactions and uncovers novel interaction patterns. These findings highlight the potential of interpretable AI approaches for elucidating complex molecular interactions in neurodegenerative disease.

items.title: IsoPrism predicts isoform usage from short-read transcriptomes through structure-guided competitive allocation
items.title_zh: IsoPrism通过结构引导的竞争性分配从短读长转录组预测异构体使用
items.summary_zh: 摘要 短读长（SR）单细胞和空间转录组学表征基因表达，但对基因内异构体使用的分辨率有限。在此我们提出IsoPrism，一个结构引导的竞争性分配框架，从基因水平表达预测异构体比例。IsoPrism将个体表达和局部表达上下文与转录本结构注释相结合，使用共享迭代更新来保持非负、基因归一化的比例。来自个体长读长（LR）计数和组水平异构体使用的联合监督使得在没有匹配LR测量的样本中进行预测成为可能。在源自三个配对转录组资源的五种迁移场景中，IsoPrism在八种评估方法中取得了最高的平均主导异构体准确率、组成相似性和簇水平分配相关性。消融分析支持结构查询、表达上下文、迭代分配和双分辨率监督的互补贡献。应用于发育中的小鼠皮层图谱，IsoPrism识别了阶段和细胞类型相关的异构体使用模式，包括两个Pkm转录本预测相对使用的变化。IsoPrism通过从配对LR参考转移信息，实现了SR转录组的异构体使用分析

extra.description: Abstract Short-read (SR) single-cell and spatial transcriptomics characterize gene expression but provide limited resolution of within-gene isoform usage. Here we present IsoPrism, a structure-guided competitive allocation framework that predicts isoform proportions from gene-level expression. IsoPrism combines individual expression and local expression context with transcript structural annotations, using shared iterative updates to preserve non-negative, gene-normalized proportions. Joint supervision from individual long-read (LR) counts and group-level isoform usage enables prediction in samples without matched LR measurements. Across five transfer scenarios derived from three paired transcriptomic resources, IsoPrism achieved the highest mean dominant isoform accuracy, compositional similarity, and cluster-level allocation correlation among eight evaluated methods. Ablation analyses supported complementary contributions from structural queries, expression context, iterative allocation, and dual-resolution supervision. Applied to a developing mouse cortex atlas, IsoPrism identified stage- and cell-type-associated isoform-usage patterns, including variation in the predicted relative usage of two Pkm transcripts. IsoPrism enables isoform-usage analysis of SR transcriptomes by transferring information from paired LR references, extending the analytical value of existing single-cell and spatial gene-expression atlases.

items.title: Diversity analysis of actinomycetes from the gut of Pheretima aspergillum and bioactive secondary metabolites from an anti-Enterococcus faecalis strain
items.title_zh: 参环毛蚓肠道放线菌多样性分析及一株抗粪肠球菌菌株的生物活性次级代谢产物
items.summary_zh: 摘要 背景 抗菌素耐药性是全球最紧迫的公共卫生挑战之一，耐万古霉素肠球菌（VRE）被世界卫生组织列为高优先级病原体。动物肠道环境因与宿主长期共同进化而 harbors 具有独特生物合成潜力的放线菌。参环毛蚓是一种用于中药的药用蚯蚓，持续摄入复杂有机底物，产生选择压力可能驱动其肠道共生体中新次级代谢途径的进化。然而，参环毛蚓肠道放线菌的多样性、可培养资源和抗VRE潜力仍 largely 未探索。结果 本研究首次系统表征了参环毛蚓肠道放线菌多样性。高通量16S核糖体RNA（16S rRNA）扩增子测序揭示参环毛蚓肠道细菌群落高度多样，包含21门、75纲、141目、263科、501属和608个推定物种。放线菌门排名第三优势门（相对丰度10.2%）。使用八种培养基共回收414株可培养肠道相关细菌分离株，其中332株（80.2%）为放线菌；414株中26株（6.3%）被鉴定为推定新物种。菌株CB1-

extra.description: Abstract Background Antimicrobial resistance is one of the most pressing global public health challenges, with vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus (VRE) listed as a high-priority pathogen by the World Health Organization. Animal gut environments harbor actinomycetes with unique biosynthetic potential due to long-term coevolution with hosts. Pheretima aspergillum , a medicinal earthworm used in traditional Chinese medicine, continuously ingests complex organic substrates, creating selective pressures that may drive the evolution of novel secondary metabolic pathways in its gut symbionts. However, the diversity, culturable resources, and anti-VRE potential of gut actinomycetes from P. aspergillum remain largely unexplored. Results This study presents the first systematic characterization of the gut actinomycete diversity of P. aspergillum . High-throughput 16 S ribosomal RNA (16 S rRNA) amplicon sequencing revealed that the gut bacterial community of P. aspergillum is highly diverse, comprising 21 phyla, 75 classes, 141 orders, 263 families, 501 genera, and 608 putative species. Actinomycetota ranked as the third most dominant phylum (10.2% relative abundance). A total of 414 culturable gut-associated bacterial isolates were recovered using eight culture media, of which 332 (80.2%) were actinomycetes; 26 of the 414 isolates (6.3%) were identified as putative novel species. Strain CB1-10-1, identified as Streptomyces chartreusis , exhibited broad-spectrum antimicrobial activity against vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus faecalis (VREfa) and other pathogens. Whole-genome sequencing and genome mining identified 38 biosynthetic gene clusters (BGC). One type II polyketide synthase cluster showed a high-confidence match to the characterized benastatin BGC (BGC0000204.5). Integrated metabolomic analysis further confirmed the production of benastatin analogues. Guided by this multi-omics strategy, benastatin B and benastatin C were isolated and structurally identified, representing the first report of benastatin production by S. chartreusis . Moreover, this study is the first to demonstrate that benastatin B exhibits potent anti-VREfa activity, with a minimum inhibitory concentration of 2 µg/mL and a minimum bactericidal concentration of 4 µg/mL – both superior to vancomycin – and it shows bactericidal properties. Conclusions This study establishes P. aspergillum as a productive source of actinomycete diversity harboring potential novel species. The multi-omics-guided discovery approach led to the identification of benastatin B as a promising bactericidal lead compound against VREfa infections, providing proof-of-concept for the value of animal symbiotic actinomycetes in antimicrobial drug discovery and a foundation for future mechanistic and preclinical studies.

items.title: AnnelidaDB: a comprehensive platform of taxonomic and multi-omic resources across annelids
items.title_zh: AnnelidaDB：一个跨环节动物的分类学和多组学资源综合平台

extra.description: Abstract Annelids inhabit marine, freshwater, and terrestrial ecosystems and are important models for studying animal evolution, regeneration, and host–microbe interactions, yet their rapidly growing omics resources remain dispersed across repositories and publications. We developed AnnelidaDB (www.annelidadb.com), a species-centred database built on an updated phylogenetic framework that integrates genomes, mitochondrial genomes, transcriptomes, proteomes, epigenomes, single-cell datasets, host-associated symbiont genomes, and comparative synteny for Annelida. The current release covers 1121 species, including 152 species with nuclear genomes, 177 with mitochondrial genomes, 591 with transcriptome data, 5 with single-cell datasets comprising 209 802 cells, and 30 bacterial symbiont genomes. AnnelidaDB organizes these resources through 10 navigation directories and connects species, genome, gene, functional annotation, and gene-family records. Users can browse genomic assemblies, explore interactive single-cell atlases and 12 200 precomputed Oxford plots, run BLAST queries and search genes against the annelid-specific database, and submit chromosome-level data for syntenic analysis against 20 Annelida linkage groups. Sequences, annotations, and private results are available for download. As a comprehensive multi-omics resource dedicated to annelids, AnnelidaDB provides an accessible platform for comparative investigations of annelid genome evolution, adaptation, regeneration, and symbiosis.

items.title: DiseaseCIO: a multi-omics atlas for characterizing clinical intervention outcomes across diverse diseases
items.title_zh: DiseaseCIO：一个用于表征多种疾病临床干预结局的多组学图谱
items.summary_zh: 摘要：患者间临床干预结局的异质性是精准医学的主要障碍。多维高通量组学的整合有助于揭示临床干预差异的分子基础，并为结局预测、预后分层、调控模式和耐药机制提供见解。我们推出DiseaseCIO（疾病临床干预结局，http://db.edbc.org/DiseaseCIO/），一个将微生物组、转录组和表观基因组数据与人类疾病干预结局整合的数据库。它旨在在个体患者水平表征与疾病干预结局相关的分子景观。DiseaseCIO涵盖来自94种疾病状态的42,798份治疗前样本，覆盖涉及377种药理学和非药理学干预的510种治疗方案。这些样本包括从八个采样位置收集的四种标本类型。使用定制的iMOD多组学数据处理工作流，我们生成了20类分子特征，并识别出超过184万个候选特征-结局关联。DiseaseCIO还提供交互式工具，用于差异分析、预后评估、跨组学相关分析、多维特征的跨队列整合分析，以及用户提交特征集的

extra.description: Abstract Heterogeneity in clinical intervention outcomes across patients is a major barrier to precision medicine. The integration of multidimensional high-throughput omics can help reveal the molecular basis of differences in clinical interventions and provide insights into outcome prediction, prognostic stratification, regulatory patterns, and resistance mechanisms. We present DiseaseCIO (Disease Clinical Intervention Outcomes, http://db.edbc.org/DiseaseCIO/), a database that integrates microbiome, transcriptome, and epigenome data with human disease intervention outcomes. It is designed to characterize the molecular landscape associated with disease intervention outcomes at the individual patient level. DiseaseCIO encompasses 42 798 pretreatment samples from 94 disease states, covering 510 treatment regimens involving 377 pharmacological and non-pharmacological interventions. These samples comprise four types of specimens collected from eight sampling locations. Using the customized iMOD workflow for multi-omics data processing, we generated 20 categories of molecular features and identified >1.84 million candidate feature–outcome associations. DiseaseCIO also provides interactive tools for differential analysis, prognostic evaluation, cross-omics correlation analysis, and cross-cohort integrative analysis of multidimensional features as well as enrichment analysis and signature construction for user-submitted feature sets. DiseaseCIO provides a molecular-level resource for exploring intervention outcome heterogeneity across diseases and identifying candidate multi-omics biomarkers associated with treatment response and prognosis.

items.title: XYcellAtlas: a cell-type- and spatial-resolved pan-cancer atlas of sex-biased and Y chromosome loss-associated molecular signatures
items.title_zh: XYcellAtlas：一个细胞类型和空间分辨的泛癌图谱，涵盖性别偏倚和Y染色体丢失相关分子特征
items.summary_zh: 摘要：性别是癌症易感性、临床预后和治疗反应的关键决定因素。性染色体异常，特别是男性恶性肿瘤中Y染色体体细胞丢失（LOY），对转录调控、肿瘤免疫微环境重塑和恶性进展产生深远影响，凸显了全面整合单细胞和空间组学图谱以解析人类癌症中性别偏倚和LOY景观的迫切需求。在此，我们开发了XYcellAtlas（http://www.xycellatlas.top/），一个整合数据库，用于在单细胞转录组、表观基因组和空间转录组分辨率下整合和多维可视化人类组织中的性别差异和LOY特征。该资源汇集了来自6764份患者样本的数据，覆盖18种癌症类型、8种癌前病变和21种组织来源，包含超过2580万个单细胞和100万个空间转录组点。利用在正常组织数据集上训练的随机森林分类器，XYcellAtlas量化了跨细胞类型的细胞类型特异性LOY频率。此外，它系统编录了性别偏倚和LOY相关分子改变，包括差异表达基因、染色质峰

extra.description: Abstract Sex is a critical determinant of cancer susceptibility, clinical prognosis, and therapeutic response. Sex chromosome aberrations, particularly somatic loss of the Y chromosome (LOY) in male malignancies, exert profound impacts on transcriptional regulation, tumor immune microenvironment remodeling, and malignant progression, highlighting an urgent demand for comprehensive integration of single–cell and spatial omics profiles dissecting sex-biased and LOY landscapes across human cancers. Here, we developed XYcellAtlas (http://www.xycellatlas.top/), an integrative database for integration and multidimensional visualization of sex disparities and LOY features across human tissues at single-cell transcriptomic, epigenomic, and spatial-transcriptomic resolutions. This resource aggregates data from 6764 patient samples covering 18 cancer types, eight precancerous lesions, and 21 tissue origins, encompassing over 25.8 million single cells and one million spatial-transcriptomic spots. Leveraging random forest classifiers trained on normal tissue datasets, XYcellAtlas quantifies cell-type-specific LOY frequencies across cell types. Furthermore, it systematically catalogs sex-biased and LOY-associated molecular alterations, including differentially expressed genes, chromatin peaks, core transcription factors, as well as their functional annotations and dysregulatory signatures within malignant cells and the tumor microenvironment. In summary, XYcellAtlas provides a unified, all-in-one analytical platform enabling researchers to query, inspect, quantify, and visualize sex-associated and LOY-derived multi-omics features underlying tumor evolutionary processes.

items.title: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署

items.summary_zh: 物联网(IoT)中激增的流量, 影响了传感器等设备的数据传输。利用软件定义网络(SDN)技术可以优化网络性能, 提高数据传输质量。然而, 物联网中流量等网络状态的不断变化会影响软件定义网络控制平面的性能。研究软件定义物联网(SD-IoT)中的动态控制器部署问题, 以在流量变化时保证控制平面性能。考虑到物联网节点的能耗以及数据传输的特点, 在部署控制器时, 综合考虑延迟、控制可靠性以及能耗的影响, 并将该问题构建为马尔可夫博弈过程。为了同时兼顾单一控制器性能以及控制平面整体性能, 采用多智能体深度强化学习求解该问题。在部署阶段利用动作掩码屏蔽部分节点, 避免将控制器部署在性能不足或者供能不方便的节点。仿真实验表明, 与基于Louvain社区划分和基于单智能体深度Q网络(DQN)的部署算法相比, 所提算法可以更好地找到高性能的部署方案。

items.title: 云网融合环境下组合服务的动态重构
items.title_zh: 云网融合环境下组合服务的动态重构
items.summary_zh: 随着云计算与空天地海一体化通信网络的深度融合, 各种复杂应用场景的出现使得组合服务的种类和数量急剧增多, 结构也变得复杂。在云网融合环境下, 用户移动设备和边缘服务器等硬件能力有限, 能耗问题成为组合服务进行动态重构不可忽略的重要因素。此外, 传统方法并未考虑空天地海不同场景下用户对不同服务质量(QoS)属性需求的差异性, 使得组合服务的交付结果并不令人满意。为了解决上述问题, 提出一种基于多目标粒子群优化(PSO)的组合服务动态重构方法。该方法首先根据重构原子服务的三维空间地理位置和功能进行聚类, 有效解决在云网融合环境下服务规模庞大情况下的搜索空间爆炸问题; 然后通过能耗计算模型得到服务调用的综合能耗, 并将其作为动态重构的优化目标之一, 结合服务的多种QoS属性进行多目标寻优, 最终生成符合用户需求且能耗较低的重构方案。实验结果表明, 该方法在云网融合环境下节约能耗和应对较大候选服务

items.title: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.title_zh: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.summary_zh: 在高速收费站拥堵检测场景中, 遮挡、阴影、景深等因素严重影响检测算法的精度, 基于单信息的拥堵检测算法无法准确反映收费站真实拥堵情况, 对此, 提出一种高速收费站多信息融合拥堵检测算法。首先采用目标检测算法检测目标区域车辆, 利用图像空间特征计算车道占用率; 其次利用Deep SORT目标跟踪算法与滑动平衡机制进行车流量综合估计, 减少因为遮挡和阴影导致的车辆误检、漏检问题; 最后利用基于光流信息熵的车速估计方法, 降低因景深变化导致的拥堵状态检测误差。通过融合3种不同维度信息得到拥堵指数, 拥堵指数聚类为5种拥堵类别以判断真实拥堵状态, 从而实现高速收费站的拥堵检测。实验结果表明, 在高速收费站拥堵数据集上, 采用多信息融合的拥堵检测算法准确率达到90.4%, 能够实现对收费站拥堵状态的准确检测。

items.title: Arm机密计算架构研究进展与展望

items.title: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.title_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统,也叫智能体操作系统,是整合大模型、工具资源以及多智能体协同的核心平台,目前正逐渐成为推动通用人工智能发展的一个关键研究方向。对智能体操作系统领域的研究进展进行了系统梳理,首先从基础理论着手,回顾了多种大模型的演进情况以及智能体和传统操作系统领域的进展;接着,围绕典型体系结构,如AIOS等,阐述了其分层架构与模块化设计是怎样达成资源管理与智能调度的。进一步地,明确了当前智能体操作系统在上下文整合、扩展性以及安全性等方面面临的技术挑战,同时也提出了未来借助轻量化设计、自监督学习机制以及动态调度算法来提升多智能体协作效率。该研究的主要贡献为,将那些分散的研究给予整合,促使技术框架变得更为明晰,并指出了智能体操作系统对新兴体系以及行业定制化实践覆盖不全面的情况。未来的研究需要侧重推动跨域智能体操作系统自我进化的能力,并且加快其在各个领域的落地等。

items.title: 实际应用场景中的大模型高效推理技术综述
items.title_zh: 实际应用场景中的大模型高效推理技术综述
items.summary_zh: 近年来,大语言模型(Large Language Models,LLMs)技术迎来了快速发展,其在各行业的应用呈现出蓬勃增长的态势。从自然语言处理到智能推荐,再到信息检索和自动化写作,LLMs正逐渐成为许多领域中不可或缺的工具。然而,随着应用场景的逐渐多样化和需求的不断增加,LLMs推理效率问题日益凸显。在实际应用场景中,快速准确的推理能力对于响应用户请求、处理大规模数据和实时决策至关重要。为了应对这一挑战,学术界展开了广泛的研究和探索,致力于提高LLMs的推理效率。对此,全面调研了实际应用场景中有关LLMs高效推理的文献。首先,介绍了LLMs推理的原理,并分析了在实际应用场景中如何提高LLMs的推理效率。然后,引入了一个针对实际应用场景的分类系统,其主要分为3个层面,分别是算法优化层面、参数优化层面和系统优化层面;并对大模型进行相关研究的总结和归纳。最后,探讨了未来可能的研究方向。

items.title: 基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法

items.title: 大模型赋能战术对抗仿真实验体系架构及技术路径研究
items.title_zh: 大模型赋能战术对抗仿真实验体系架构及技术路径研究
items.summary_zh: 战术对抗仿真实验是作战分析、模拟训练和基于仿真的装备活动的核心手段,其智能化、自动化水平直接影响实验效能和战斗力的生成。针对传统仿真实验存在的实验设计、模型构建、导调控制和人机交互效率低等问题,参考MCP协议提出大模型赋能战术对抗仿真实验的体系架构。该架构包含基础层、工具资源层、AI Agent层、赋能层、应用层,这5层架构自顶向下牵引,自底向上逐层整合,可实现大小模型与数据资源和传统小模型的耦合聚合,并赋能基于仿真的各项军事活动。在此基础上,重点研究讨论了大模型赋能战术对抗仿真实验的具体路径:大模型赋能仿真实验设计,大模型赋能决策模型构建,大模型赋能导调控制。最后,分析了大模型赋能战术对抗仿真实验面临的挑战,并给出了相应的应对措施。

items.title: Attribution-based diagnostics for single-cell foundation models
items.title_zh: 基于归因的单细胞基础模型诊断
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA基础模型（scFM）越来越多地用于计算机生物发现，但仅凭预测性能无法揭示其决策依赖的是具有生物学意义的信号还是模型特定的捷径。我们系统研究了两个任务中下游预测的事后归因：使用预训练Cell2Sentence和scGPT模型进行细胞类型注释，以及在受控设置中使用scGPT+STATE进行扰动预测。对于细胞注释，我们使用归因评估预测是否依赖已确立的标记基因，以及它们的相关性如何随模型架构、表达排名和周围细胞上下文变化。对于扰动预测，我们在合成设置中将归因模式与已知调控真值比较，以评估它们对模型学习计算的揭示。在这些任务中，归因揭示了生物特征使用、上下文交互、不同输入通路的贡献、学习进展、与预测质量的关联，以及标准性能指标未完全捕捉的潜在陷阱。使用完整和有限调控知识的实验进一步表明，从归因得出的结论强烈依赖于生物参考、基线和零模型的选择。总之，这些发现凸显了归因作为灵活事后诊断的价值

extra.description: Single-cell RNA foundation models (scFMs) are increasingly used for in-silico biological discovery, yet predictive performance alone does not reveal whether their decisions rely on biologically meaningful signals or model-specific shortcuts. We systematically investigate post-hoc attribution of downstream predictions across two tasks: cell-type annotation using pretrained Cell2Sentence and scGPT models, and perturbation prediction using scGPT+STATE in a controlled setting. For cell annotation, we use attribution to assess whether predictions rely on established marker genes and how their relevance varies with model architecture, expression rank, and the surrounding cellular context. For perturbation prediction, we compare attribution patterns with known regulatory ground-truth in a synthetic setting to assess what they reveal about the model's learned computations. Across these tasks, attribution reveals biological feature use, contextual interactions, contributions from different input pathways, learning progression, associations with prediction quality, and potential pitfalls that are not fully captured by standard performance metrics. Experiments with complete and limited regulatory knowledge further demonstrate that conclusions drawn from attribution depend strongly on the choice of biological reference, baseline, and null model. Together, these findings highlight the value of attribution as a flexible post-hoc diagnostic for understanding model behavior, identifying potential issues, and informing the development of scFMs.

items.title: Rethinking One Gene, One Token: Transcriptome-Aware Tokenization for Single-Cell Foundation Models
items.title_zh: 重新思考一基因一标记：面向单细胞基础模型的转录组感知标记化
items.summary_zh: 单细胞基础模型通常将每个基因视为一个标记，这既昂贵又浪费。一个细胞可以表达数千个基因，因此每个基因一个标记使自注意力计算代价高昂，然而其中许多基因以低水平检测到，携带的信号太少，不值得拥有自己的标记。一起表达的基因可以共享一个标记，而为突出的基因保留单独的标记。我们介绍scTAT（转录组感知标记化），它将基因集词汇表与逐细胞分词器配对。该词汇表包含在预训练语料中具有稳定相对表达的重叠基因集。使用这些集合带来两个困难。第一，哪些基因应共享一个标记取决于细胞，而现有多基因标记预先固定分组。第二，不同大小的基因集必须与单基因在共同尺度上比较。因此分词器逐细胞决定，让基因集和单基因在按集合大小平方根归一化的表达分数下竞争标记位置。训练仍然重建单个基因，因此预测保持在基因分辨率。在冻结嵌入细胞类型注释中，scTAT以一半的标记预算匹配最强的一基因一标记模型。在相同预算下，其相对于一基因一标记模型的优

extra.description: Single-cell foundation models typically treat each gene as a token, which is both costly and wasteful. A cell can express thousands of genes, so one token per gene makes self-attention expensive, yet many of these genes are detected at low levels and carry too little signal to deserve a token of their own. Genes that are expressed together could instead share a token, leaving separate tokens for genes that stand out. We introduce scTAT (Transcriptome-Aware Tokenization), which pairs a gene-set vocabulary with a per-cell tokenizer. The vocabulary holds overlapping gene sets that recur with stable relative expression across the pretraining corpus. Using these sets raises two difficulties. First, which genes should share a token depends on the cell, whereas existing multi-gene tokens fix the grouping in advance. Second, gene sets of different sizes must be compared with single genes on a common scale. The tokenizer therefore decides per cell, letting gene sets and single genes compete for token positions under an expression score normalized by the square root of set size. Training still reconstructs individual genes, so predictions stay at gene resolution. In frozen-embedding cell-type annotation, scTAT matches the strongest one-gene-per-token model with half the token budget. Its advantage over one-gene-per-token models at the same budget grows as the budget shrinks and the tokenizer assigns more positions to gene sets. Encoding the same genes with gene-set tokens also nearly halves the Transformer's matrix-multiplication cost. These results show that a token need not hold exactly one gene: when the tokenizer decides per cell which genes share a token, a fixed budget covers more of each transcriptome at no cost in annotation accuracy.

items.title: HELICS: Biobank-scale Conditional Synthetic Genome Generation via Latent Flow Matching
items.title_zh: HELICS：通过潜在流匹配进行生物样本库规模的条件合成基因组生成
items.summary_zh: 个体水平基因型数据支撑遗传发现、疾病风险建模和治疗开发，然而许多关键场景仍数据有限，包括代表性不足的祖先群体、罕见或不平衡疾病队列以及受限访问的生物样本库。条件合成基因组生成将支持隐私感知的基准测试、模拟和数据增强，但需要学习数十万至数千万相关单核苷酸多态性（SNPs，即DNA变异位点）上的超高维离散分布。我们引入HELICS：通过潜在插值条件合成的高保真生成，一个无定相潜在流匹配框架，用于从生物样本库规模基因型数据进行全基因组SNP水平生成。HELICS用卷积自编码器对染色体进行标记化，将>600K SNPs缩减为4,096个连续潜在标记，并在拼接的多染色体潜在表示上训练参数化条件流匹配的transformer模型。在英国生物样本库超过417K基因组上训练，HELICS无需单倍型定相即可生成全基因组常见变异合成队列，并比现有基于单倍型的模拟器更忠实于真实基因型，包括外部评估中高等位基因频

extra.description: Individual-level genotype data underpin genetic discovery, disease-risk modeling, and therapeutic development, yet many critical settings remain data-limited, including underrepresented ancestries, rare or imbalanced disease cohorts, and restricted-access biobanks. Conditional synthetic genome generation would support privacy-aware benchmarking, simulation, and data augmentation, but requires learning an ultra-high-dimensional discrete distribution over hundreds of thousands to tens of millions of correlated single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs), or sites of DNA variation. We introduce HELICS: High-fidelity gEneration via Latent Interpolant Conditional Synthesis, a phasing-free latent flow matching framework for genome-wide SNP-level generation from biobank-scale genotype data. HELICS tokenizes chromosomes with convolutional autoencoders, reducing >600K SNPs to 4,096 continuous latent tokens, and trains a transformer parameterized conditional flow matching model over the concatenated multi-chromosome latent representation. Trained on over 417K genomes in the UK Biobank, HELICS generates genome-wide common-variant synthetic cohorts without haplotype phasing and achieves stronger fidelity to real genotypes than existing haplotype-based simulators, including high allele-frequency agreement in external evaluation and superior preservation of local and long-range SNP correlation structure. Conditioning on ancestry and genetic liability summaries enables targeted generation across genetic risk profiles; in perturbation analyses, by increasing the conditioned disease trait liability, HELICS induces SNP-level dosage changes in generated genomes that are highly correlated with published association weights. HELICS provides a scalable generative modeling framework for SNP-level genome data and a path toward conditional synthetic cohorts for data-limited genetic studies.

items.title: Comparative Strategies for Handling Imbalanced QSAR Regression: A Case Study on hERG Activity Prediction
items.title_zh: 处理不平衡QSAR回归的比较策略：hERG活性预测案例研究
items.summary_zh: 数据不平衡在QSAR建模中经常出现，但大多数研究集中于分类任务，很少涉及回归任务，因为确定数据的稀疏或密集区域具有挑战性。数据级和算法级的不平衡处理策略可能对模型性能产生不同影响。在本研究中，我们系统比较了GCN和基于指纹的机器学习模型中的各种策略。为更有意义地评估模型性能，我们基于领域知识和数据分布将目标区域划分为若干子区域。我们重点关注最具实际意义的区域。结果表明，基于该关注区域指标选择模型比使用总区域指标能带来更可靠的性能。我们还观察到，不同不平衡处理策略的效果因模型类型而异。这些发现凸显了回归QSAR建模中区域感知评估的重要性，并为不平衡数据集选择适当策略提供了实用指导。

extra.description: Data imbalance frequently occurs in QSAR modeling, yet most studies focus on classification tasks, and few address regression tasks, as it is challenging to determine which regions of the data are sparse or dense. Data-level and algorithm-level imbalance-handling strategies can have different effects on model performance. In this study, we systematically compare various strategies across GCN and fingerprint-based machine learning models. To evaluate model performance more meaningfully, we partitioned the target region into several subregions based on both domain knowledge and data distribution. We focused on the region of greatest practical interest. Our results demonstrate that selecting models based on this interest-region metric leads to more reliable performance than using the total region metric. We also observed that different imbalance-handling strategies can have divergent effects depending on the model type. These findings highlight the importance of region-aware evaluation in regression QSAR modeling and provide practical guidance for selecting appropriate strategies for imbalanced datasets.

items.title: HistoTx: Early fusion of H&E images and spatial transcriptomics at varying spatial transcriptomics resolution with self-supervised learning
items.title_zh: HistoTx：在不同空间转录组学分辨率下，通过自监督学习对H&E图像和空间转录组学进行早期融合
items.summary_zh: 空间转录组学绘制组织切片上的基因表达图谱，当与全切片图像整合时，可联合捕获形态结构和分子活动，从而提供组织生物学的丰富多模态视图。将空间转录组学与WSI结合的ML方法通常通过对比对齐或对病理基础模型进行监督微调，学习从形态特征到分子谱的映射。在这两种情况下，转录组学都作为训练信号而非真正的输入模态，使推理从根本上由图像驱动。我们提出一种早期融合视觉Transformer架构，其中转录组token以任意空间分辨率构建，与图像块token合并，并通过共享Transformer堆栈联合处理，以实现深度跨模态交互。从预训练的纯视觉病理基础模型出发，我们通过在配对的图像和空间转录组学数据上继续自监督预训练来训练HistoTx，并证明：1）在仅使用图像进行推理时，性能在大多数任务上与基线持平，同时在本质上受益于分子知识的任务（如基因表达预测）上有所提升；2）当推理时两种模态均可用时，联合提供图像和转录

extra.description: Spatial transcriptomics maps gene expression across tissue sections and, when integrated with whole slide images, jointly captures both morphological architecture and molecular activity to provide a rich, multimodal view of tissue biology. ML approaches combining spatial transcriptomics and WSIs typically learn a mapping from morphological features to molecular profiles via contrastive alignment or supervised fine-tuning of pathology foundation models. In both cases, transcriptomics serves as a training signal rather than a true input modality, leaving inference fundamentally image-driven. We propose an early-fusion vision transformer architecture in which transcript tokens are constructed at arbitrary spatial resolution, merged with image patch tokens, and jointly processed through a shared transformer stack for deep cross-modal interaction. Starting from a pretrained vision-only pathology foundation model, we train HistoTx by continuing self-supervised pretraining on paired image and spatial transcriptomics data and demonstrate that: 1) at inference with image only, performance remains on par with the baseline on most tasks while improving on tasks that inherently benefit from molecular knowledge, such as gene expression prediction; 2) when both modalities are available at inference, jointly providing image and transcript inputs outperforms either modality alone.

items.title: GraphTFactor: A graph-based approach for proteins transcription factor prediction
items.title_zh: GraphTFactor：一种基于图的蛋白质转录因子预测方法
items.summary_zh: 转录因子（TF）在调控基因表达中发挥重要作用，使其识别成为计算生物学的基本任务。在这项工作中，我们提出GraphTFactor，一种新颖的端到端框架，将蛋白质序列建模为图并直接分类转录因子。通过将序列编码为图结构，所提方法自然处理可变长度输入，同时保留相关关系信息，而不施加长度约束。实验结果表明，GraphTFactor在基准数据集上优于最先进方法，展示了基于图的表示用于TF预测的有效性，同时提供对模型预测贡献序列区域的可解释见解。为支持可重复性和实际采用，我们发布了一个开源软件包和一个交互式网络应用，使用户能够轻松对自定义序列进行TF预测。

extra.description: Transcription factors (TFs) play an important role in regulating gene expression, making their identification a fundamental task in computational biology. In this work, we propose GraphTFactor, a novel end-to-end framework that models protein sequences as graphs and directly classifies transcription factors. By encoding sequences into graph structures, the proposed approach naturally handles variable-length inputs while preserving relevant relational information, without imposing length constraints. Experimental results show that GraphTFactor outperforms state-of-the-art methods on benchmark datasets, demonstrating the effectiveness of graph-based representations for TF prediction while providing interpretable insights into the sequence regions contributing to the model's predictions. To support reproducibility and practical adoption, we release an open-source software package and an interactive web application that let users easily perform TF prediction on custom sequences.

items.title: An autoencoder outperforms two transformers on prediction of gene expression from chromatin accessibility
items.title_zh: 自编码器在从染色质可及性预测基因表达上优于两个 transformer
items.summary_zh: 从染色质可及性预测 RNA 丰度的模型很少在相同特征、目标和指标下比较。我们在来自 19 项人类研究的 126,604 个配对单核图谱上构建了一个基准，共享 50,000 个峰和 3,185 个基因的词表、十个 5x2 交叉验证折和一个评分目标，并在 70 次训练运行中比较了七个已实现流程和两个参考预测器；每个流程保留自己的输入归一化和原生训练目标。基于双变分自编码器的 scButterfly-B 流程在所有六十个配对折比较中，在每基因和细胞内 Spearman 相关上优于所有 transformer 流程，包括自回归 Perceiver 模型（Omic Translator）和无支持重构的 Cisformer，训练时间短 3.8 倍。Transformer 流程在细胞内轮廓形状上差距为 0.02-0.04，但在每基因相关上落后 0.10-0.24。在两个留出细胞类型上每基因相关较低；对照

extra.description: Models that predict RNA abundance from chromatin accessibility are rarely compared under the same features, targets and metrics. We built one benchmark on 126,604 paired single-nucleus profiles from 19 human studies with a shared vocabulary of 50,000 peaks and 3,185 genes, ten 5x2 cross-validation folds and one scoring target, and compared seven implemented pipelines and two reference predictors across 70 trained runs; each pipeline keeps its own input normalisation and native training target. The scButterfly-B pipeline, built on dual variational autoencoders, outperformed every transformer pipeline, including an autoregressive Perceiver model (Omic Translator) and a support-free reformulation of Cisformer, on per-gene and within-cell Spearman correlation in all sixty paired fold comparisons, with 3.8 times shorter training. Transformer pipelines come within 0.02-0.04 on within-cell profile shape but lag by 0.10-0.24 on per-gene correlation. On two withheld cell types per-gene correlation is low; controls show the podocyte values are typical of within-type correlation for seen cell types of the same size, whereas Paneth values match a cell-agnostic shuffle for every Omic Translator arm. Within the transformer family, prespecified ablations show the Perceiver encoder was worth +0.0439 in within-donor per-gene correlation over full self-attention, a chromosome-aware genomic attention prior reduced it by 0.0096 (exact donor-level sign-flip test, Holm-adjusted p = 1.2e-4), and decoder output order had no detectable effect. A training-mean profile reaches 0.314 within-cell correlation with no input and a constant at the true expressed-gene positions reaches 0.996 per-gene correlation, so oracle-support protocols are reported only as diagnostics. Code, results and an audited release are provided.

items.title: Coupling cellular trajectories and RNA kinetics on continuous expression manifolds with ManifoldVelo
items.title_zh: 在连续表达流形上耦合细胞轨迹与RNA动力学：ManifoldVelo
items.summary_zh: 从静态单细胞转录组中联合恢复伪时间和RNA速率，需要协调全局轨迹结构与局部表达变化，尤其是在复杂周期和分支分化中。在此我们介绍ManifoldVelo，一个拓扑条件框架，联合学习细胞坐标、连续RNA轨迹和调控动力学。未剪接和剪接RNA轨迹的导数与转录-剪接-降解动力学相匹配，包括在观测细胞之间，使表达重建、细胞排序和动力学估计相互 informing。ManifoldVelo在所有评估的单细胞轨迹类型中恢复伪时间，包括循环、多分支和光滑非分支轨迹。ManifoldVelo在多峰循环模拟中在所比较方法中实现最佳伪时间恢复，并在多峰循环和分支模拟中实现剪接RNA速率最高方向一致性。真实数据分析支持跨实验板的相位预测，以及与胰腺发育阶段和标记表达一致的分化轨迹。其核心优势在于在可复用的动态参考中联合恢复不同轨迹结构中的时间位置和局部动力学。新细胞仅从剪接RNA即可获得伪时间和速率预测，无需重新拟

extra.description: Jointly recovering pseudotime and RNA velocity from static single-cell transcriptomes requires reconciling global trajectory structure with local expression changes, particularly in complex cycles and branching differentiation. Here we introduce ManifoldVelo, a topology-conditioned framework that jointly learns cellular coordinates, continuous RNA trajectories and regulatory kinetics. Derivatives of unspliced and spliced RNA trajectories are matched to transcription-splicing-degradation dynamics, including between observed cells, allowing expression reconstruction, cellular ordering and kinetic estimation to inform one another. ManifoldVelo recovers pseudotime across all evaluated single-cell trajectory types, including cyclic, multibranch and smooth non-branching trajectories. ManifoldVelo achieves the best pseudotime recovery among compared methods in multipeak cyclic simulations and the highest directional agreement for spliced RNA velocity in both multipeak cyclic and branching simulations. Real-data analyses support phase prediction across experimental plates and differentiation trajectories consistent with pancreatic developmental stages and marker expression. Its central advantage is the joint recovery of temporal position and local dynamics across distinct trajectory structures within a reusable dynamic reference. New cells are assigned pseudotime and velocity predictions from spliced RNA alone, without refitting the reference model. ManifoldVelo provides a foundation for dynamic cell atlases that transfer learned temporal and kinetic information to new samples.

items.title: Pycea: a scverse toolkit for single-cell lineage tracing analysis
items.title_zh: Pycea：一个用于单细胞谱系追踪分析的scverse工具包
items.summary_zh: 谱系追踪能够重建发育、再生和疾病中的细胞历史，但将谱系数据整合到单细胞分析工作流程中仍然具有挑战性。我们介绍Pycea，一个用于谱系分析和可视化的Python工具包，以及TreeData，AnnData的扩展，将谱系树与细胞测量一起存储。TreeData与Scanpy和其他scverse工具兼容，无需在格式之间转换即可实现集成分析。Pycea提供可扩展的方法用于树可视化、分支识别、距离比较、祖先状态推断和谱系统计。该软件是开源的，可在https://github.com/YosefLab/pycea获取。

extra.description: Lineage tracing enables reconstruction of cellular histories in development, regeneration, and disease, but integrating lineage data into single-cell analysis workflows remains challenging. We introduce Pycea, a Python toolkit for lineage analysis and visualization, and TreeData, an extension of AnnData that stores lineage trees alongside cellular measurements. TreeData is compatible with Scanpy and other scverse tools, enabling integrated analysis without converting between formats. Pycea provides scalable methods for tree visualization, clade identification, distance comparisons, ancestral state inference, and lineage statistics. This software is open source and available at https://github.com/YosefLab/pycea.

items.title: BARRR: Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression for Multi-View Multi-Cohort Data
items.title_zh: BARRR：用于多视图多队列数据的双向增强降秩回归
items.summary_zh: 跨多个队列（即样本组）和视图（即来源或模态）的双向数据整合在生物医学研究中至关重要，以从异质数据集中获得整体见解。然而，大多数现有整合方法侧重于单一维度，如跨不同来源的多视图整合或跨不同样本组的多队列整合。现有的双向整合方法稀缺且主要无监督，忽视了协变量提供的宝贵见解。为解决这一空白，我们引入双向增强降秩回归（baRRR）方法。我们的方法同时建模协变量相关和不相关效应，同时在两个维度上分解效应水平（全局、部分共享和个体）。大量模拟证明了我们的方法在信号恢复、结果预测和缺失数据插补方面的优势。我们将方法应用于癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）数据，使用体细胞突变作为协变量来告知不同组学平台和癌症类型间的变异模式。这些研究突出了其作为生物医学研究中稳健且适应性强的整合分析工具的潜力。

extra.description: Bidimensional data integration across multiple cohorts (i.e., sample groups) and views (i.e., sources or modalities) is crucial in biomedical research to derive holistic insights from heterogeneous datasets. However, most existing integrative methods focus on a single dimension, such as multi-view integration across distinct sources or multi-cohort integration across distinct sample groups. Existing approaches for bidimensional integration are scarce and predominantly unsupervised, overlooking the valuable insights offered by covariates. To address this gap, we introduce the Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression (baRRR) method. Our approach models covariate-related and unrelated effects concurrently, while also decomposing effect levels (global, partially shared, and individual) across both dimensions. Extensive simulations demonstrate the advantages of our method with respect to signal recovery, outcome prediction, and missing data imputation. We apply our approach to data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), using somatic mutations as covariates to inform patterns of variability across different omics platforms and cancer types. These studies highlight its potential as a robust and adaptable tool for integrative analysis in biomedical research.

items.title: Reducing double-dipping in single-cell topic models with three-way count splitting
items.title_zh: 用三向计数拆分减少单细胞主题模型中的双重 dipping
items.summary_zh: 主题模型从单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据中学习基因程序，然后相同的计数被用于测试哪些基因和供体与这些程序相关。计数拆分是这种复用的标准补救措施，但当编码器读取每个细胞的计数时尚未被测试。在一个104,400细胞的狼疮队列中，每次运行300个置换零基因，朴素检验在名义5%水平下拒绝了36%的零基因-主题对，而通常的两向拆分拒绝了38%，因为编码器看到了被检验基因自身的留出计数。在单独的第三个计数上编码主题使用，使用beta-二项稀疏化，将此降低到7.7%（模型外基因为6.7%）；对于另外两个模型LDVAE和scETM，该率为7.0-7.3%（朴素为51-59%）。一个无标签干扰素程序在狼疮队列和预先指定的COVID-19队列的留出计数中发生偏移，供体水平主题使用预测疾病（AUROC 0.96），超越细胞类型比例（两个队列中分别为0.86和0.58）。校准和预测不依赖于模型。我们不

extra.description: Topic models learn gene programs from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data, and the same counts are then used to test which genes and donors are associated with those programs. Count splitting is the standard remedy for this reuse, but it has not been tested when an encoder reads each cell's counts. On a 104,400-cell lupus cohort with 300 permuted null genes per run, naive tests rejected 36% of null gene-topic pairs at a nominal 5% level, and the usual two-way split rejected 38%, because the encoder sees the tested gene's own held-out count. Encoding topic usage on a separate third of the counts, with beta-binomial thinning, lowered this to 7.7% (6.7% for genes outside the model); for two other models, LDVAE and scETM, the rate was 7.0-7.3% (naive 51-59%). A label-free interferon program shifts in held-out counts in the lupus cohort and in a pre-specified COVID-19 cohort, and donor-level topic usage predicts disease (AUROC 0.96) beyond cell-type proportions (0.86 and 0.58 in the two cohorts). Calibration and prediction did not depend on the model. We do not claim better clustering, prediction or topic stability. Code, figures and result tables are public (MIT license; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23307193).

items.title: Protocol for Discovering Convergent Molecular Networks across Multi-Omics Datasets Using Network Propagation
items.title_zh: 使用网络传播跨多组学数据集发现趋同分子网络的方案
items.summary_zh: 表型结果源于分子层之间的协调变化。尽管多组学数据捕捉互补的分子信号，但由于基因水平重叠有限，将其整合为连贯的生物机制仍然具有挑战性。网络传播将每个数据集中的重要基因命中映射到先验知识分子相互作用网络上，并将其信号扩散到邻近基因。对传播网络进行数学整合，随后进行聚类和通路富集，可揭示共享分子网络，从而指出跨正交分子层捕捉到的核心生物学。

extra.description: Phenotypic outcomes arise from coordinated changes across molecular layers. Although multi-omics data capture complementary molecular signals, integrating them into coherent biological mechanisms remains challenging due to limited overlap at the gene level. Network propagation maps significant gene hits from each dataset onto a prior knowledge molecular interaction network and diffuses their signals to neighboring genes. Mathematical integration of propagated networks, followed by clustering and pathway enrichment, reveals shared molecular networks, pinpointing the core biology captured across orthogonal molecular layers.

items.title: BEAKER: An Expert-Curated Benchmark for Embodied Brains in Self-Driving Chemical Laboratories
items.title_zh: BEAKER：一个用于自驱动化学实验室中具身大脑的专家策划基准
items.summary_zh: 自驱动化学实验室（SDCL）正将化学实验推向具身自动化，机器必须感知实验室场景、推理实验状态，并在物理、程序和安全约束下行动。尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLM）越来越多地被考虑为此类系统的具身大脑，但现有实验室基准主要关注安全性、异常检测或一般科学理解，使其面向执行的具身能力未得到充分探索。为填补这一空白，我们介绍BEAKER，一个用于评估SDCL中具身可操作性、知识、实验和推理的基准。BEAKER包含1,000个专家策划的问答样本，涵盖11种图像和视频任务类型，覆盖化学实验室执行所需的关键判断，包括可供性 grounding、轨迹规划、设备、状态和安全识别、装置设置、操作和步骤推理以及时间程序推理。所有问题和注释均由化学和具身人工智能（AI）专家手动创建和审查，没有AI辅助生成或注释。我们在离线、单轮设置中评估了28个通用、科学导向、化学专业化和具身MLLM。结果表明，当前模型可以在视频中

extra.description: Self-Driving Chemical Laboratories (SDCLs) are moving chemical experimentation toward embodied automation, where machines must perceive laboratory scenes, reason about experimental states, and act under physical, procedural, and safety constraints. Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly considered as embodied brains for such systems, existing laboratory benchmarks mainly focus on safety, anomaly detection, or general scientific understanding, leaving their execution-oriented embodied capabilities underexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce BEAKER, a Benchmark for evaluating Embodied Actionability, Knowledge, Experimentation, and Reasoning in SDCLs. BEAKER contains 1,000 expert-curated question-answer samples across 11 image and video task types, covering key judgments required for chemical laboratory execution, including affordance grounding, trajectory planning, equipment, state, and safety recognition, apparatus setup, operation and step reasoning, and temporal procedure reasoning. All questions and annotations are manually created and reviewed by chemistry and embodied Artificial Intelligence (AI) experts, without AI-assisted generation or annotation. We evaluate 28 general-purpose, science-oriented, chemistry-specialized, and embodied MLLMs in an offline, single-turn setting. Results show that current models can follow coarse experimental procedures in videos, but still struggle to ground actions into operable regions and feasible trajectories, to recognize fine-grained laboratory apparatus, states, and safety norms, and to order steps in mid-length procedures. BEAKER thus reveals a clear gap between coarse procedural understanding and the precise, action-grounded perception required for laboratory execution, providing a diagnostic benchmark for future MLLMs in SDCLs.

items.title: FrontierPhysics: Evaluating Agents for End-to-End Physics Research
items.title_zh: FrontierPhysics：评估智能体进行端到端物理研究
items.summary_zh: AI智能体在物理研究中发挥着越来越重要的作用。然而，现有物理基准仅评估固定问题、孤立子任务或给定解决方案的论文复现，很少在正确性之外检查研究质量。我们介绍FrontierPhysics，一个端到端基准，包含42位物理学家基于自身研究制作的56个任务，涵盖理论、计算和实验物理的九个领域。每个任务要求智能体回顾文献、制定研究计划、进行研究和实验，并产生结构化输出和科学手稿。结合确定性验证器和专家撰写的评分标准，FrontierPhysics评估智能体的研究是否正确且可发表。在26种配置的22个模型中，没有配置通过其168次运行中的超过46次。对智能体轨迹的人工审查表明，前沿智能体的主要弱点是推理不够严谨和专家直觉有限，而不是物理知识差距或执行错误。

extra.description: AI agents are playing an increasingly important role in physics research. However, existing physics benchmarks only evaluate fixed questions, isolated sub-tasks, or paper reproduction with given solutions, and rarely check research quality alongside correctness. We introduce FrontierPhysics, an end-to-end benchmark with 56 tasks made by 42 physicists based on their own research, covering nine domains across theoretical, computational, and experimental physics. Each task requires agents to review the literature, develop a research plan, conduct research and experiments, and produce structured outputs and scientific manuscripts. Combining deterministic verifiers with expert-authored rubrics, FrontierPhysics evaluates whether agents' research is correct and publishable. Across 22 models in 26 configurations, no configuration passes more than 46 of its 168 rollouts. Manual review of agent trajectories shows that frontier agents' main weaknesses are insufficiently rigorous reasoning and limited expert intuition, rather than gaps in physics knowledge or execution errors.

items.title: Reinforcement Learning Enables Scaling Generalist Robot Policy Improvement
items.title_zh: 强化学习实现通用机器人策略改进的扩展
items.summary_zh: 通用机器人策略的引入使得单个大型模型能够从庞大的预训练语料中学习执行各种任务。虽然这些模型通常表现出强大的零样本泛化能力，但它们通常需要适应阶段才能在部署中达到足够性能。通过强化学习（RL）的迭代自我改进已显示出实现这种适应的前景，然而此类方法主要在单任务设置中探索——目标只是改进狭窄的部署任务——这与基础策略的多任务能力形成鲜明对比。在这项工作中，我们询问通用机器人策略是否能够在部署中实现多任务、通用改进——同时针对许多不同任务——以及什么算法配方能够实现这一点。为回答这个问题，我们首先开发了一套结构化评估来测试通用改进能力，并系统评估关于价值估计、策略提取和资源分配的算法和实践设计选择。我们表明，通用策略不仅可以在线跨不同任务改进，而且正确的配方可以实现泛化并提高在线训练期间未考虑的任务的性能。我们描述了这种泛化何时发生，并表明训练任务分布和基于价值的RL的使用都至关重要。据我们所知，

extra.description: The introduction of generalist robot policies has enabled a single, large model to learn to perform a variety of tasks from a vast pre-training corpus. While these models often exhibit powerful zero-shot generalization capabilities, they typically require an adaptation phase to achieve sufficient performance in deployment. Iterated self-improvement via reinforcement learning (RL) has demonstrated promise in enabling this adaptation, yet such approaches have been largely explored in single-task settings - where the goal is to simply improve on a narrow deployment task - which lies in stark contrast to the multi-task capabilities of the base policy. In this work we ask whether generalist robot policies are capable of multi-task, generalist improvement in deployment - targeting many diverse tasks simultaneously - and what algorithmic recipe enables this. To answer this question, we first develop a set of structured evaluations to test generalist improvement capabilities, and systematically evaluate algorithmic and practical design choices regarding value estimation, policy extraction and resource allocation. We show that not only can generalist policies be improved online across diverse tasks, but that the right recipe can enable generalization and increase performance on tasks not considered during online training. We characterize when this generalization occurs and show that both the training task distribution and the use of value-based RL are critical. To the best of our knowledge, this is among the first evidence for online generalist improvement for robot foundation models.

items.title: Occlusion for Free: Detecting Occlusion from the Disagreement Between Two Monocular Distance Cues
items.title_zh: 免费遮挡：从两个单目距离线索之间的不一致检测遮挡
items.summary_zh: 知道行人被遮挡对机器人有用，即使检测器无法恢复隐藏像素，但遮挡估计器通常在有遮挡注释的数据上训练，而部署设置很少有这样的注释。我们表明，遮挡可以从仅相机管道已经计算的两个距离估计中读出。表观高度在很大程度上不受遮挡影响，因为检测到的框仍然跨越整个人；单目度量深度被拉向遮挡物，因为深度图报告的是框内最近的表面。只有它们的顺序重要，因此不需要焦距、身高或深度尺度，前提是深度模型的误差接近纯增益，这一条件可以在没有标签的情况下检查。该分数在KITTI上以AUC 0.909检测严重遮挡（在所有注释行人上为0.888，包括检测器遗漏的行人），不需要训练和遮挡标签，并且不是距离的代理：在固定距离带内它保持AUC 0.894-0.925，而真实距离单独接近随机。在具有测量可见性的合成CARLA场景中，它达到0.819，而距离单独为0.644。我们是在测量了三种标准架构对遮挡的响应——深度融合、遮挡模拟增

extra.description: Knowing that a pedestrian is occluded is useful to a robot even when the detector cannot recover the hidden pixels, but occlusion estimators are normally trained on occlusion annotations that deployment settings rarely have. We show that occlusion can be read off two distance estimates a camera-only pipeline already computes. Apparent height is largely unchanged by occlusion, because the detected box still spans the whole person; monocular metric depth is pulled toward the occluder, because the nearest surface inside the box is what a depth map reports. Only their ordering matters, so no focal length, stature, or depth scale is needed, provided the depth model's error is close to a pure gain, a condition that can be checked without labels. The score detects heavy occlusion on KITTI with AUC 0.909 (0.888 over all annotated pedestrians, including those the detector misses), requires no training and no occlusion labels, and is not a proxy for range: within fixed distance bands it holds AUC 0.894-0.925 while true distance alone sits near chance. On synthetic CARLA scenes with measured visibility it reaches 0.819, against 0.644 for distance alone. We arrived here after measuring three standard architectural responses to occlusion, depth fusion, occlusion-simulating augmentation, and attention, none of which improved detection outside its training distribution in the configurations we tested, and after finding that a detector trained on German roads loses half its accuracy on self-annotated street scenes in Lagos, Nigeria. Signals that need no local annotation are worth more in settings that benchmarks do not represent.

items.title: Adaptive Multi Mode: Budget-Aware Routing of Optimizers By Online Landscape Probes
items.title_zh: 自适应多模式：通过在线景观探测的预算感知优化器路由

extra.description: The best classical optimizer for a continuous black-box problem depends on its budget and landscape. Existing routers decide from the dimension and budget, past improvement or features fitted to one benchmark, and few test an optimizer's implicit assumptions online. AMM (Adaptive Multi Mode) routes a known budget among quasi-Newton, trust-region, coordinate, multistart and evolution-strategy optimization engines with online probes of curvature, plateaus, separability, kinks, basins and fractal structure. Each probe has a default, a dimension-by-budget validity range and a cost charged to the budget. In its pre-registered development loop on bbob, 32 of 36 predictions held over the last 16 confirmations. AMM was then tested once on held-out bbob instances 101-110 (D=2-40, 10*D-1000*D) against up to seven competitors. It has the highest target share in 382 of 600 function-dimension-budget cells (236 outright, 146 tied) and, by a descriptive posterior rule, is credibly behind in 35, mostly at 10*D and 30*D. At every budget it also leads the controls built from its own engines (the best engine alone, the best engine per dimension and budget, and a greedy schedule), narrowly at 10*D and 30*D, and nevergrad's NgIohTuned. In pre-registered runs its lead over IPOP-CMA-ES holds under affine and box transformations, on box-constrained bbob and, pooled, on rotated f2-f4, but rotating the separable f3 and f4 removes most of the lead there. On held-out MA-BBOB its final share at 2000*D is level with IPOP-CMA-ES's and its anytime area lower. We published AMM as an open-source Python package (pip install amm-optimizer; https://github.com/BjBodner/amm-optimizer).

items.title: CounterFactual Retrieval for Evidence-Aware Individual Animal Identification
items.title_zh: 反事实检索用于证据感知的个体动物识别
items.summary_zh: 个体动物的自动识别正从小型精选研究转向共享基准和可重用的基础模型。这一进展有用，但当前评估使匹配背后的证据未解决，即高检索准确率并不表明模型使用了动物特征还是身份相关捷径。我们用反事实前景检索（CFR）解决这个问题，一个证据感知的评估协议。CFR在不同视图下评估相同的查询-库任务：完整图像、仅前景和仅捷径。完整图像测量标准检索性能；仅前景测量前景支持的检索；仅捷径视图测量从背景或轮廓可恢复多少身份信号。这将检索分数转变为证据概况：模型在原始图像上的表现如何，当仅可见动物时该性能保留多少，以及当动物被移除时可恢复多少身份信号。我们发布了34个数据集约0.5M掩码以及掩码生成和CFR评估的代码。

extra.description: Automated identification of individual animals is moving from small curated studies toward shared benchmarks and reusable foundation models. This progress is useful, but current evaluation leaves the evidence behind a match unresolved, i.e., high retrieval accuracy does not show whether a model used animal features or identity-correlated shortcuts. We address this with Counterfactual Foreground Retrieval (CFR), an evidence-aware evaluation protocol. CFR evaluates the same query-gallery task under different views: full image, foreground-only, and shortcut-only. The full-image measures standard retrieval performance; the foreground-only measures foreground-supported retrieval; and shortcut-only view measure how much identity signal is recoverable from background, or silhouette. This turns a retrieval score into an evidence profile: how well the model performs on the original images, how much of that performance remains when only the animal is visible, and how much identity signal remains recoverable when the animal is removed. We release around 0.5M masks for 34 datasets and code for mask generation and CFR evaluation.

items.title: Balancing hierarchical representation and quantization: A performance trade-off in text embeddings
items.title_zh: 平衡分层表示和量化：文本嵌入中的性能权衡
items.summary_zh: 分层文本嵌入模型提供可变长度表示，而量化降低数值精度；两者都旨在提高计算效率。这项工作是对这两种正交的、已经建立的技术如何相互作用的实证基准研究。我们使用四个基于Transformer的嵌入模型评估Massive Text Embedding Benchmark（MTEB）中的38个任务，涵盖1D和2D分层表示与32位、8位和二进制量化的组合，每个任务168种配置。我们分别报告每个效率维度：理论每向量存储和端到端评估时间。在Friedman检验与Nemenyi事后分析下，int8量化对于配对分类和重排序与float32在统计上不可区分，总体成本最多1.5个百分点，而二进制量化在每个任务类别中都显著更差。将嵌入维度减半一次在$m=16$以上不可统计检测；连续两次减半总是可以。将8倍降维与int8结合，在基线有效性的94.4%下实现每向量存储减少32倍。由于评估时间仅测量一次，我们将其视为指示

extra.description: Hierarchical text embedding models offer variable-length representations, while quantization reduces numerical precision; both aim to improve computational efficiency. This work is an empirical benchmark study of how these two orthogonal, already-established techniques interact. We evaluate 38 tasks from the Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB) using four transformer-based embedding models, covering 1D and 2D hierarchical representations combined with 32-bit, 8-bit, and binary quantization, for 168 configurations per task. We report each efficiency dimension separately: theoretical per-vector storage and end-to-end evaluation time. Under a Friedman test with Nemenyi post-hoc analysis, int8 quantization is statistically indistinguishable from float32 for pair classification and re-ranking and costs at most 1.5 percentage points overall, whereas binary quantization is significantly worse across every task category. Halving the embedding dimension once is not statistically detectable above $m=16$; two successive halvings always are. Combining an 8x dimensionality reduction with int8 yields a 32x reduction in per-vector storage at 94.4% of baseline effectiveness. Because evaluation times were measured once, we treat them as indicative: we find no evidence that quantization speeds up evaluation, whereas sampling from intermediate layers shortens it substantially. Retrieval degrades far faster than every other category, so we report findings per task category.

items.title: Cross-modal transfer enables zero-shot prediction of drug responses across cell types
items.title_zh: 跨模态迁移实现跨细胞类型的药物反应零样本预测
items.summary_zh: 遗传扰动反应捕捉基因水平干预的功能后果，为药物反应预测提供超越基线基因表达的功能信息。在同一细胞背景下，遗传和化学扰动参与共享调控网络，为在扰动模态之间转移反应信息提供生物学基础。在此我们介绍GRAFT，一个结合遗传到化学转移与跨上下文预测的框架，在目标上下文中没有药物测量的情况下推断药物诱导的转录反应。在基准LINCS和外部上下文中，GRAFT在反应相关性、方向一致性和幅度重建方面优于竞争方法，特别是对于具有上下文依赖反应的药物。GRAFT-Adapt进一步使用来自目标上下文的少量药物测量来细化未测量反应的预测。GRAFT-Atlas涵盖13个细胞上下文和7,856个药物目录条目，包括102,128个药物-上下文组合的预测。该图谱捕捉了可识别的药理学邻域、共享功能程序、上下文依赖的转录变化以及分子对接支持的结构-功能关联。在来自不同供体的十个iPSC系中，GRAFT识别了候选供体间差异，

extra.description: Genetic perturbation responses capture the functional consequences of gene-level interventions, providing functional information for drug-response prediction beyond baseline gene expression. Within the same cellular context, genetic and chemical perturbations engage shared regulatory networks, providing a biological basis for transferring response information between perturbation modalities. Here we introduce GRAFT, a framework that combines genetic-to-chemical transfer with cross-context prediction to infer drug-induced transcriptional responses without drug measurements in the target context. Across benchmarked LINCS and external contexts, GRAFT improved response correlation, directional agreement and magnitude reconstruction over competing methods, particularly for drugs with context-dependent responses. GRAFT-Adapt further refines predictions of unmeasured responses using a small number of drug measurements from the target context. GRAFT-Atlas spans 13 cellular contexts and 7,856 drug catalog entries, comprising 102,128 predictions for drug-context combinations. The atlas captured recognizable pharmacological neighborhoods, shared functional programs, context-dependent transcriptional changes and structural-functional associations supported by molecular docking. Across ten iPSC lines from distinct donors, GRAFT identified candidate inter-donor differences, with functional support for selected candidates from measured genetic perturbation responses. Together, GRAFT enables perturbation-informed prediction and comparison of drug responses across cellular contexts.

items.title: Continuous mass measurement of single proteins
items.title_zh: 单蛋白的连续质量测量

extra.description: Nature Methods, Published online: 30 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03275-8 We developed an approach to monitor the mass of individual proteins and the complexes they form for up to an hour by mass photometry.
